language.label: App language
language.hint: Only on this computer. Messages from the server and emails stay in Portuguese for now.

windows.macOpenHint: While running, Aureum stays connected: calls, messages and notifications keep coming. It stays in the Dock and in the menu bar icon. To quit for good, use Cmd+Q.
windows.macLoginHint: Opens Aureum when you sign in to your Mac account.
windows.trayHint: In the tray, Aureum stays connected: calls, messages and notifications keep coming. To quit for good, use Quit Aureum in the tray icon.
windows.loginHint: Opens Aureum when you turn on the PC (installed app only).
windows.windowHint: Aureum opens with the loading screen and checks for updates right away.
windows.trayStartHint: Aureum stays only in the tray icon, connected, until you open it.

appearance.saveError: Couldn't save to the server. The change applies only on this PC for now.
appearance.contrastHint: Text over the color and links adjust their contrast on their own to stay readable.

notifications.officialHint: @aureum sends notices in a read-only conversation, pinned at the top of your messages. Choose what you want to get.
notifications.muteHint: To only turn off the sound, mute the conversation: messages keep coming.

seguranca.title: Security
seguranca.description: Password or email changed and sign-ins on a new computer. Always on, and notifies even with the conversation muted.

eventos.title: Events
eventos.description: Reminders for events you answered Going or Maybe to, and notices when they change.

bugs.title: Bugs
bugs.description: When a problem you reported is fixed.

convites.title: Invites
convites.description: When someone joins with one of your invites.

novidades.title: What's new
novidades.description: What changed in each new version of the app.

avisos.title: Notices
avisos.description: General notices from the Aureum team.

privacy.receiptsHint: In one-on-one conversations, shows when the other person saw your messages. Off, they don't see when you read, and you don't see when they read either.

sounds.ownHint: They confirm what you did. They keep playing in Do not disturb.
sounds.othersHint: Muted in Do not disturb; incoming calls become just a missed call notice. During a call, messages play quieter.
sounds.soundboardHint: The sounds people play in the servers' rooms.

tips.title: Tour and tips
tips.tourHint: A quick look at the tabs, Home, the panels and your profile.
tips.resetDone: Done: the tips show up again when you use each thing.
tips.firstTimeHint: The bubbles that show up when you use something for the first time.

about.creditsHint: Aureum is built on open source projects. Thanks to the people who maintain them.
about.excalidrawFonts: The whiteboard's fonts come with Excalidraw, each under its authors' license.
